moment: Wanted/notice board of pinned parchment posters outside a frontier-town building
why: Weathered planks, nailed curling parchment sheets, dusty street at the edge: classic Old West wanted-poster board. Could be any Western, but the grimy-realistic RDR look is the closest.

moment: Engineering-college lecture hall, chalkboard with a sunbeam and a chalk-drawn drone
why: Green chalkboard, wooden frame, hard sunbeam; only weakly specific on its own. Fits the 3 Idiots classroom once the later frames are seen, but taken alone it is just a generic classroom.

moment: Yellow scooter parked at a high-altitude blue lake (Pangong, Ladakh) at golden hour
why: Ladakh lake + yellow scooter evokes the film's final act. Alternative reading is Roman Holiday (Vespa), but the landscape does not match.

moment: Outlaw gang camp at sunset: covered wagon, tents, tethered horses, cauldron over a campfire above a lake
why: Gang-camp composition with wagon, canvas tents, crates and cook pot over fire is almost exactly RDR2's camp (Horseshoe Overlook / Lake Isabella vibe).

moment: Quadcopter hovering in a brutalist college courtyard in daylight
why: Looks like a real-world/AI render of a hand-built drone on a concrete-and-brick campus; no film world is evoked. Possibly the same campus as the 3 Idiots classroom frames, but I would not claim it.

moment: Tattered black-sailed ghost ship looming out of dark fog at night, with an octagonal compass and a dotted trail
why: Black Pearl / ghost-ship silhouette with ragged sails and lantern-lit stern windows; the gold octagonal compass reads as Jack Sparrow's compass.

moment: Night-sky ceiling with dozens of floating candles
why: Hovering candles against a starry enchanted ceiling is the Great Hall signature.

moment: Floating candles drifting past in a dark starry sky
why: Same candle-and-starfield motif; the horizontal pen-stroke/quill marks suggest writing. Hogwarts by association, little else to go on.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean / Sea of Thieves
moment: Storm-dark open sea with a glowing teal wave and a tall ship silhouette on the horizon
why: Moody ocean with a distant sailing ship and the same gold compass icon; pirate-sea mood, more game/film-poster than a specific scene.

moment: Arthur Morgan's journal: cream paper with pencil sketches of pines, a saddled horse, a lake, a pinned note
why: Hand-drawn pencil scrapbook with taped note and Western scenery strongly echoes the RDR2 journal.

moment: Hogwarts castle across a night lake, floating candles reflected in the water, a broomstick sweeping across
why: Castle on a crag with lit windows, candles in the air and a flying broom: unmistakably Hogwarts.

moment: Gang camp at dusk, lantern-lit canvas tent, covered wagon, campfire with cook pot, snow-capped mountains
why: Same camp as J004, dimmer; RDR2's Grizzlies/Colter-era camp feel.

moment: Hogwarts Express crossing the Glenfinnan Viaduct above a Scottish loch
why: Red steam engine on a curved stone arch viaduct in the Highlands is the exact film shot.

moment: Journal page with a red underline, a crossed-out photo-grid placeholder, pencil forest/horse sketch
why: Same pencil-journal language as J010; reads as RDR2 journal, though the crossed grid is abstract.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean / Sea of Thieves
moment: Treasure-map strip: compass, dotted route, skull gear and an X, beneath a stormy-sea photo
why: Gold compass, dashed route to an X and skull emblem say 'pirate treasure map'; the franchise is a guess between the films and Sea of Thieves.

moment: Wooden desk with a boxed fancy pen and a pocket watch, a chalkboard and sunny window behind
why: Classroom desk, ceremonial pen box, school window; the pen-handover feels like a 3 Idiots beat but it could equally be Dead Poets Society. Low confidence.

moment: Yellow scooter circled and ticked on a lakeshore at sunset
why: Same Ladakh-lake scooter shot as J003 with a highlight ring and check mark.

film: Red Dead Redemption 2 / Red Dead Redemption
moment: Lonely farmstead at a blood-red sunset: gnarled oak, fence, dirt track, distant Rockies, X marks in the sky
why: Red-ochre western sunset over a ranch in the grass strongly evokes Beecher's Hope-type RDR vistas.

moment: The Great Hall: long tables with goblets and plates, hundreds of floating candles, tall gothic window
why: Unmistakable layout and floating candles.

moment: The Black Pearl-style ghost ship in moonlit fog, with a dotted route line ending in an X
why: Torn black sails, lantern-lit stern, teal-lit water.

moment: Wanted-poster board with a large central parchment and smaller curled sheets
why: Same as J001 in a slightly different crop; RDR2-style bounty board.

moment: Great Hall with long tables and fewer floating candles, a progress line at the bottom
why: Same Great Hall plate as J019.

moment: Home-built quadcopter flying beside a stone-and-concrete campus arcade
why: Photoreal/AI render of a drone on a college campus; no film or game world in it.

moment: Crimson-sky ranch with oak tree, house, rutted track and a line with X waypoints, crows overhead
why: Western ranch at sunset with a trail line and X markers reads as RDR's map-and-ride feel.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean / Sea of Thieves
moment: Sunset sea with a lone tall ship and a glowing teal wake; compass-and-route strip below
why: Ship on the horizon with a luminous teal wake and treasure-route graphic: pirate adventure at sunset.

moment: Golden-hour valley with a river, a grazing horse and a dark oak in the foreground
why: Hazy sun, lone horse in grassland and mountains is RDR2's signature pastoral vista.

moment: Empty lecture hall, sunlit colonnade, chalkboard with a drone drawing and 'AAL IZZ WEL(L)'
why: The chalkboard literally reads 'AAL IZZ WELL' (the film's catchphrase) in the engineering-college lecture hall; text is part of the artwork.

moment: Ghost ship in darkness with a treasure-map panel (X, dotted route, compass rose) over it
why: Dim version of the black-sailed ship with a parchment-style map overlay.

moment: Moonlit harbour at night with masts and lantern-lit quay, treasure-route strip below
why: Tall ships at a lit pier under a moon, plus the compass: Port Royal / pirate-harbour mood. Generic otherwise.

moment: Dark campfire at night with two tents against black mountains
why: Night camp beside a small fire; consistent with the other RDR camp frames but quite generic by itself.

moment: Golden-hour valley with a grazing horse under a dark tree, fading in from black
why: Same vista as J026.

moment: Candle-lit dark room with a parchment on the floor cracking with ink veins, castle visible through windows
why: Floating candles, a castle through the window and a magical parchment: Hogwarts / Marauder's Map territory.

film: Pirates of the Caribbean / Sea of Thieves
moment: Storm sea with glowing teal wave, distant ship, compass at right
why: Same plate as J009.

moment: Boxed fountain pen and pocket watch on a school desk, drone sigil on the chalkboard
why: Same as J016; the pen-in-a-box moment loosely echoes the film's pen subplot, but low confidence.

moment: Black-sailed ghost ship under a moon with Jack-Sparrow-style octagonal compass and a trailing line
why: Ragged sails and lanterns plus the unmistakable gold compass.

moment: Folded parchment map with footprints walking corridors and a ribbon label
why: Creased vellum, inked corridors and trails of footprints is the Marauder's Map.

moment: Opening of the Marauder's Map: banner scroll, compass medallions at the corners, footprints
why: Footprints, folds, corner compass medallions and a ribbon title.

moment: Night-sky ceiling of floating candles with one candle singled out in a viewfinder bracket
why: Candles hovering in a dark starfield; Hogwarts by association.

moment: Lecture hall, chalk drone drawing, 'AAL IZZ WELL' on the board
why: Chalkboard literally reads 'AAL IZZ WELL' in an Indian engineering-college classroom.
